scope: opt-in bounded owner attribution; not feature900 or memory leak certification

plan.workload: existing mixed search/evidence/A/writer cadence; no input or limit changes
plan.latency: diagnostic distribution only; original non-memory mode gate unchanged

ledger.attributed: sum categories except unattributed; no use_count multiplier
ledger.unattributed: used-attributed; unknown callsites stay unknown; negative or category sum mismatch is invalid
ledger.overlap: roles below describe the same tickets and must not be added to ledger; visual index is outside ledger

modelsLimits.address: internal lookup only; detached before free; never emitted
modelsLimits.destroy: opaque identity destruction event after object delete and ticket release
modelsLimits.registration: Complete models register after successful Build. During Build a model ticket may exist before registry identity; ledger bytes remain fully counted, completed-model count is not all construction objects.

snapshotLimits.middleState: no export between inserted entry and bytes update

recentEvents.interpretation: recent ring only; eventSequence reveals overwritten prefix. TTL/count/byte events have cumulative counters, not exact individual timestamp; do not reconstruct unobserved lifetime causality.

clock.internalProcess: proc_pid_rusage RSS and footprint; domain ledger and role registry sampled sequentially, not atomic
clock.externalCycle: latest internal owner + receivedNs, external observer FD/anonymous/workspace/mutations and monotonic timestamps; preserve age/skew; never sum nonsimultaneous peaks
clock.disableBoundary: nearest owner row plus actual boundary monotonic timestamp; not forced fresh product read

diagnosticOverhead.bounded: 128 model scalar slots + pointer keys,16 pools,32 recent events,14 counters; per-domain13 category totals/ticket views; stack16KiB formatting and fixed copied arrays. No strong observer model ownership. Existing log cap unchanged.
diagnosticOverhead.layout: Reservation/model/matches/document/visualIndex admission sizeof unchanged vs baseline (mac arm64 24/176/64/600/112B). Small diagnostics-only pool key, PreparedSource byte gauge, RequestMedia gauges and publication activity fields are observability overhead, not product owner bytes.
diagnosticOverhead.timing: opt-in ledger/registry mutex and scalar updates add cost; measured execution is instrumented, not R136 equivalent timing

collector: strict numeric schema, same pid, increasing times, bounded lines/count, phase completeness, no incomplete diagnostic tail, final ticket/models/pools/live all zero; late failure propagates
notClaimed: TTL expiration in mixed load if max8 eviction occurs first
whole heap no leak from logical zero
